description: Everyday actions to project onto the fitted axes. Categories: virtuous, vicious, neutral, plus the four dissociation cells that separate virtue from sentiment (virtuous_unpleasant, vicious_pleasant, pleasant_nonmoral, unpleasant_nonmoral). None of these sentences appear in the training pairs.
